units.source_text: 我虽空归，你泪湿的衣袖还是不得干燥的。

en.t: Though I return with nothing, your sleeves wet with tears still cannot dry.

units.source_text: 这正是强迫我走的报应吧。”

en.t: This must be the retribution for forcing me to leave.

units.source_text: 公主想道：“我的恶名定将没来由地传播出去了。

en.t: The princess thought, "My bad name is sure to spread without any cause.

units.source_text: 但‘心若问时’，我总可坦白回答。”

en.t: But when my heart asks me, I can always answer honestly."

units.source_text: 便用十分疏远的态度对待夕雾。

en.t: So she treated Yugiri with a very distant manner.
